14:02Arm做得不错的一点是，他们表示M系列将提供一套标准外设，NVIK就是其中之一。NVIK是嵌套向量中断控制器，是处理中断的标准方法。​​​​​​​​​​​​

14:02One of the nice things that Arm has done is that they've said for the M series. they're going to give a standard set of peripherals, and the NVIK is one of those That's the nested vectored interrupt controller, that is a standard way of handling interrupts.

14:19嗯，它还包含一些类似Cystic定时器的东西，这是一种以固定间隔触发中断的通用方法。正是nvik加上Cystic定时器，再加上一些其他外设的组合，使得操作系统从一个Cortex M芯片移植到另一个芯片变得非常容易，即使是不同厂商的芯片之间也可以。嗯，所以我们把所有这些都放在一个名为Bluenrg1 Repel的文件中，这是定义我们平台的renode平台文件。

14:19Uh, It also has things like a cystic timer, that is a universal way of firing interrupts at a regular interval, and it's this combination of uh nvik plus cystic, uh plus some other peripherals that actually makes it really easy to port operating systems from one cortex M chip to another, even across different vendors. Um, So we put these all together in a file called Bluenrg1 Repel, that is the renode platform file that defines our platform.

Bunny 的加密加速引擎

28:49关于这一点，还有一点需要说明：向用户提供硬件时，发送下载链接远比发​​送硬件本身容易得多；事实上，修补Renode甚至FPGA硬件都比修补真正的硬件要容易得多。所以，我们把这堆乱糟糟的线路称为引擎。​​​​

28:49One other story about this, Getting hardware to users, it's a lot easier to send somebody a download link than it is to send them hardware, and in fact, it's easier to patch renode or even an FPGA hardware than it is to patch real hardware. So this mess of wires is what we call the engine.

29:10这是一个密码加速引擎，因为现代的密码原语，特别是ed25519，需要大量的256位乘法器，而这些乘法器在32位5核处理器上很难实现，所以我们将其卸载到DSP上。最终，我把它设计成了一个外设，并在Renode中模拟了它，这样我们就可以像在真实硬件上运行一样运行引擎的固件，并且我们已经提交了代码，有人也进行了检查。

29:10It is a cryptographic acceleration engine because modern uh cryptographic uh primitives, particularly ed25519, uh requires a lot of 256 bit multipliers, and those can be very difficult to do on a 32 bit risk 5 core, so we offload it to a DSP That bunny ended up designing I emulated this in renode as a peripheral, so we can run the engine's firmware as if it were running on real hardware, and we checked this in and somebody checked it out.

29:47This person named Fabian Viceberg, checked it out and added these vectors from Google project white proof, which basically tests the engine a little bit better than we had done. 44:57嗯，再说一遍，这真的取决于你的目标是什么。例如，对于任天堂游戏机来说，没有什么能模拟你八岁时在圣诞节早晨玩游戏的感觉，没有任何东西可以做到。​​​​​​

45:16That can come close to that, but it is a lot harder to attach debug probes to a real nintendo system, so it depends on what you're looking to do um for a lot of what we want to do in terms of development. An emulator can be better than the real system.

45:36一个实际的例子是，Cortex M0通常带有两个Flash补丁点，允许你在只读Flash上插入断点。但当你的代码超过两个补丁点时，GDB会报错，提示你无法继续，因为它无法添加断点。这种情况经常发生在代码大量内联时，因为一行代码可能对应Flash文件中20行不同的代码。

45:36A practical example is that a cortex M0 usually comes with two flash patch points, which let you insert break points on read only flash as soon as you exceed two. GDB will throw lots of fits saying you can't continue because it can't add breakpoints, and this happens a lot when you have code, that's been heavily inlined, so a single line of code might equal 20 different lines in the flash file.

46:04如果某个函数特别繁忙，比如需要锁定并禁用中断之类的操作，通常情况下，这类函数会被到处标记。所以，如果你尝试在这个函数上设置断点，就会触发30 个断点，导致系统无法在模拟器上运行。不过这没关系，因为闪存是模拟的，所以你可以随意设置任意数量的断点。

46:04If it's a particularly hot function, things like locking disabling interrupts, that's generally a single function that gets lined everywhere. So if you try to insert a breakpoint on that, you'll hit 30 breakpoints, and your system will refuse to run with an emulator. That's no problem because flash is emulated, so you can insert as many breakpoints as you want.

46:26所以，如果你正在开发模拟器，它们可能更好，尤其是在硬件仍在不断变化的情况下，但没有什么能比得上真实硬件。因此，我们确实有连接到Jenkins服务器的真实硬件，该服务器值得信赖，会在真实硬件上运行所有这些测试。

46:26So if you're developing emulators possibly are better, especially when the hardware is still changing, but nothing beats the real thing. So we do have real hardware that is connected to a Jenkins machine with be trusted that is running all these tests on real hardware.
